prOriginalConhecido.nota: calcom/cal.com now redirects to calcom/cal.diy. Found via head branch fix/cancelled-rescheduled-workflow-emails; PR head 6048e2a8 equals the benchmark head (same 8 commits), merged as 2ebfcf448. On 2026-04-15 PR #28903 'refactor: Cal.diy' removed packages/features/ee (all workflow code) from the default branch.

tps.bug: The cron route sets the API key only on @sendgrid/mail, so the new @sendgrid/client cancellation requests are unauthenticated and reminders for cancelled bookings stay scheduled.
tps.evidenciaOpus: scheduleEmailReminders.ts only calls sgMail.setApiKey (:19) and never client.setApiKey, yet the new cancellation loop calls client.request on the @sendgrid/client singleton (:57-64); @sendgrid/mail uses its own Client instance, while emailReminderManager.ts:26 is where client.setApiKey lives. The unauthenticated request throws, the catch at :75-77 swallows it, and the cancelled reminders are neither cancelled at SendGrid nor deleted.
tps.evidenciaAstra: packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:19 initializes only sgMail, while the new cancellation request at line 57 uses the separately imported client. The locked SendGrid 7.7.0 [MailService implementation](https://github.com/sendgrid/sendgrid-nodejs/blob/7.7.0/packages/mail/src/classes/mail-service.js#L16-L38) creates its own Client, so setting its API key does not authenticate the separate client. Consequently, cancellation requests fail and leave reminders scheduled; emailReminderManager.ts:25-26 correctly initializes both clients.
